message.content:
I have everything I need. Here's my read of Apple's FY2024 10-K before placing the order:

- **Total net sales: $391,035M**, up 2% from $383,285M (FY2023); Services +13% to $96,169M offsetting flat iPhone and a 7% decline in Wearables/Home/Accessories and 8% decline in Greater China.
- Gross margin 46.2% (vs 44.1%), operating income $123,216M (+7.8%), operating cash flow $118,254M.
- Net income fell to $93,736M and diluted EPS to $6.08 only because of the one-time $10.2B net State Aid tax charge (effective tax rate 24.1% vs 14.7%) — an operating-strength story, not deterioration.
- $140.8B unrestricted cash/securities and $110B new buyback authorization (company repurchased ~112M shares at ~$222–224 in Q4 alone).

Quote: last $222.70, bid $222.68 / ask $222.72. I'll buy 40 shares at a $223.00 limit — ≈$8,920, under the $10,000 per-order cap, within the $20,000 daily cap, from the $50,000 cash balance (no money leaves the account), and the limit is only ~0.13% above themarket.
